description: Decoding round-trips a variety of claim value shapes: array, nested object, boolean, null, and number claims are rendered as compact JSON (claims emitted in sorted key order); an empty payload yields only the header algorithm, the signature segment, and the round-trip flag; a multibyte UTF-8 claim survives the base64 round trip; and a raw token string supplied directly is decoded and reported as retained unchanged.

cases.expected_output:
alg=RS256
active=true
count=5
deleted=null
iss=https://login.example.com/
meta={"a":1,"b":2}
roles=["admin","user"]
sub=user|1
signature=sig
raw_matches=true

alg=HS256
age=30
iss=https://login.example.com/
name=日本語
sub=user|99

raw_matches=true
